title: Accept and emit owns.* and applied_at frontmatter keys
action: Per D4 and the plan's frontmatter spelling: add the four flat keys `owns.code`, `owns.skills`, `owns.tests`, `applied_at` under `bee:` to the profile. Anchors (rg -n over src/verbs/knowledge): frame.rs:148 `pub(crate) const BEE_KEY_ORDER: [&str; 13] = [` — extend the array (and its size) so the new keys emit in a fixed position after `superseded_by`; frame.rs:166 `key_re_ok` already admits dotted keys, so no parser grammar change — confirm with a test that `owns.code: [a, b]` parses to a flat key and round-trips byte-identically through frontmatter.rs:66 `emit_entries` (the not_canonical guard; see tests.rs:1634 `round-trip guard: not_canonical (D12)` for the existing fixture shape). Values are flow lists of repo-relative paths; a trailing-`*` glob is a plain string here (resolution is koh-2's job). Do NOT add any of the four to frame.rs:164 `PROFILE_REQUIRED`. Author only the tests that the existing round-trip cases do not already pin: parse of each new key, emit order, and a concept carrying all four.

truths: A concept whose bee block carries owns.code / owns.skills / owns.tests / applied_at parses with zero findings and re-emits byte-identically
Existing knowledge tests stay green; PROFILE_REQUIRED is unchanged
